note: USACE campground on the western shore of Rend Lake south of the Sandusky cove, in oak and pine woods; the Rend Lake Bike Trail passes through. The best lake sites, 185 and 186 at the north tip of the Pine Tree loop, look over the water from open ground about 20-25 m back, on a bench some 6 m above the lake with a steep bank at its edge; the rest sit farther back in the woods. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, catalog, calendar and site photos read; imagery + 3DEP. 127 sites (119 electric: 100 at 50 A, 19 at 30 A; 8 walk-to tent), water at 89, sewer at 66, 7 pull-through, to 99 ft; 2027 fees $20/$24/$28 (stored $18 was 2026 electric only); season 03-26..10-31; 3-night holiday minimum. Waterfront lead: lakefront -> lakeview (closest sites atop a 4-5 m bank). Pin within ~30 m of the site centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: lakefront -> lakeview. Closest sites 186 (38.062876,-89.003603) and 185 (38.062816,-89.003345), both reservable nightly full-hookup sites in the Pine Tree loop, sit ~20-25 m from the water on open needle-strewn ground under tall trees (2023/2026 rec.gov photos show a clear open view), but 3DEP puts the pads ~6 m above the lake with a 4-5 m bank at the edge (186: 425 ft at 8 m, 410 ft at 14 m; 185: 422.5 ft at 8 m, 410.4 ft at 14 m): a bench with a climb-down, the Coon Creek 1698 case. 183/184 see the lake through a pine stand ~30 m back; 151/152 (Redbud) 60-80 m through trees; the rest farther. rec.gov's facility amenity list says 'Waterfront Sites' (no per-site attribute).
